# Certified rare excursions without detailed balance

Internal source-class extension, 2026-10-27. The operation accepts a supplied
finite, irreducible, local rational backward generator, an explicitly known
positive invariant law, and a valid lower bound on the gap of its symmetric
part. It produces a deterministic interval for the true exit-law probability
of reaching one state before returning to another. Reversibility is not a
premise. Executed examples use ordinary exact weighted GMRES. This is
neither a mathematical priority claim nor a new generic rarity complexity
class. See RESULTS.md for actual runs, failed lower degrees, and audits.

## 1. Conventions and the exact capacity identity

Let Q be a finite irreducible BACKWARD generator: Q(x,y) is the jump rate
from x to y for x != y, and Q(x,x) = -R_x. Suppose w > 0 is invariant,
w^T Q = 0, with w(a)=1, w(b)=rho in (0,1]. Put

    <f,h>_w = sum_x w(x) f(x) h(x), H=-Q,
    H*=diag(w)^(-1) H^T diag(w), S=(H+H*)/2,
    u=rho 1_a-1_b, Z=sum_x w(x).

Assume <f,Sf>_w >= g ||f||_w^2 on weighted-mean-zero functions, for
supplied g>0. Write H^# for the inverse of H on that subspace, extended by
zero on constants. This is the fundamental/group inverse, not an
unweighted Euclidean pseudoinverse.

Define p_exc as follows: start at a, leave according to q(a,y)/R_a, and
ask whether b is reached before a. Equivalently p_exc=P_a(T_b<T_a^+),
where T_a^+ includes the first departure. Let h(a)=1,h(b)=0 and let h be
Q-harmonic elsewhere. First-step equations give (Hh)(a)=R_a p_exc.
Invariance and harmonicity give (Hh)(b)=-R_a p_exc/rho. Hence

    Hh=(R_a p_exc/rho)u,
    I := <u,H^#u>_w/rho = (H^#u)(a)-(H^#u)(b)
       = rho/(R_a p_exc) > 0,
    p_exc=rho/(R_a I), stationary_capacity=rho/(Z I).

No detailed balance was used. The actual exit rate R_a is essential.

For P_t=exp(tQ), the symmetric-part gap implies contraction on weighted
mean-zero functions: differentiating ||P_t f||_w^2 gives a derivative at
most -2g||P_t f||_w^2. Thus H^#u=integral_0^infinity P_t u dt and

    I=integral_0^infinity f(t) dt,
    f(t)=<u,P_tu>_w/rho
        =rho P_t(a,a)+P_t(b,b)-P_t(a,b)-rho P_t(b,a).

The two cross terms cannot generally be merged. The integrand can be
negative at some times; tail bounds below are two-sided.

# Completed nonreversible source-class acceptance

Root accepts the stated finite-chain mathematics and executed source-class
extension. This is a completed substantive internal review. Root whole-read
the final proof, complete production code and results, including the added
endpoint-exit bound. REPLAY_N64.json pins code SHA256
e801240cf46286879d48ca384eaa12178fb31f98054aef106717946a41478a90
and proof SHA256
597c392ef67d422c91463715660ab729330b794c3190cadd4bd2beae584ed1d0.

The four-term fundamental kernel, true exit-law normalizer, weighted group
inverse, primal/dual residual identity, symmetric-part coercivity bound and
two-sided interval are correct. Detailed balance is unnecessary; a known
invariant law and valid symmetric-part gap remain essential. The stationary
directed cycles preserve the product weights, carry nonzero current and add
a nonnegative symmetric Dirichlet form to the unit-gap product heatbath.
Their weighted adjoint reverses each cycle with the same diagonal. Both sparse
actions use the correct predecessor rates. Integer scaling, GMRES normal
equations, cross terms and upward exact dyadic square-root rounding are sound.

Root independently executed a three-state irreversible control: I=3/7 while
the reversible-style proposed lower bound is87/196>3/7. The two-sided dual
radius1/63 covers the error. This preserves an actual failure of importing
the old one-sided assertion. Root replayed the64-bit case, checked exact
rho=2^-128, R_a=2363/160, Rmax=827/10, gap1, each outward radius and final
reciprocal normalization. Saved rational probability endpoints match exactly;
width6.1582e-5, root replay~.350s/~59MB processRSS.

The worker separately completed full-state killed/Poisson/adjoint controls on
five small sources and complete independent gather audits of both residuals
at32/64bits. Root did not repeat that entire control suite. No large full-state
Poisson solve or enumeration is claimed. Low-degree failures are preserved.

Root also checked the Markov inequality ||Hf||²<=2Rmax<f,Sf>, the stronger
positive denominator floor, endpoint-exit floor and lazy rational uniformisation
comparator. The latter has conditional polynomial sample/event/expected-bit
cost without1/p under known-law/gap/efficient-rational-access promises. It is
not an executed Monte Carlo experiment, a deterministic rejection-time bound
or a new generic rarity class.
